hardware.title: Hardware
hardware.incident: After seven years of reliable service, the previous FreeNAS system failed: its motherboard, CPU and several hard drives were faulty. It was time for an upgrade.

fastPool.title: Priority 2 — Fast SSD pool for services
fastPool.note: Migrate applications, databases and VMs selectively after backups and a capacity check (including snapshots). Keep media and cold data on the hard-disk pool; replicate important data to independent storage.
fastPool.selection: The MSI board has two M.2 2280 PCIe 4.0 x4 slots. Check that they are free and that both SSDs, particularly the rear one, are adequately cooled. Use a ZFS mirror, not BIOS RAID.
fastPool.capacity: 2 TB usable in the mirror (about 1.82 TiB before ZFS overhead); target around 1.45 TiB maximum, excluding overhead, to keep 20% free.
fastPool.kioxia: Kioxia EXCERIA PLUS G3 — 1,200 TBW; first choice if cheaper.
fastPool.lexar: Lexar NM790 — 1,500 TBW; alternative if similarly priced.
fastPool.priceNote: Compare the cost and warranties of two identical drives. Prices vary; no fixed retailer price.
fastPool.caution: Do not use these consumer SSDs as SLOG without power-loss protection (PLP). Defer L2ARC until there is enough RAM; do not add a special vdev with less redundancy than RAIDZ2. Verify the existing log device before changing it.

gpu.title: GPU options for local AI inference
gpu.lead: The motherboard provides one PCIe x16 slot. The final choice is primarily constrained by chassis clearance, PSU capacity and the VRAM required by the models.
gpu.priceSnapshot: Price snapshot: 24 August 2026; retail prices can change quickly.
gpu.ram: System RAM is shared by ZFS, VMs, containers and AI. See the memory priority above; GPU inference is a separate upgrade.
fit: Best fit for the existing compact chassis and 500 W PSU. Its 70 W board power, low-profile dual-slot format and 24 GB ECC VRAM make it the preferred inference upgrade.
Doubles VRAM to 48 GB and greatly expands fully-GPU model capacity, but its 300 W power draw and full-height 267 mm format likely require a larger chassis and stronger PSU.
96 GB ECC VRAM is the maximum local-inference target in this roadmap. Assume a new chassis, stronger PSU and carefully designed airflow for the 300 W Max-Q card.

models.title: Local model capacity with RTX PRO 4000 SFF
models.lead: Indicative capacity for a 24 GB GPU. Measured speeds use public benchmarks on this exact GPU where available; other figures are conservative engineering estimates and depend on quantization, context length and inference engine.
models.gpuTierTitle: Models that fit in 24 GB VRAM
models.ramTierTitle: Larger hybrid models with 128 GB system RAM
models.measured: measured on RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell SFF
models.concurrencyNote: Parallel figures assume one shared llama.cpp/vLLM-style server with continuous batching and short-to-moderate contexts. They do not mean loading a separate copy of the model for every user.
models.ramNote: System RAM does not become VRAM. Larger models use CPU/RAM offload and are therefore substantially slower than models that stay entirely on the GPU. On TrueNAS, the same 128 GB is also shared with ZFS ARC and other applications, so very large models need an explicit memory budget and sensible ARC/container limits.

memory.title: Priority 1 — 128 GB system memory
memory.current: Current: 1 × 64 GB Crucial CT64G56C46U5 DDR5; one free DIMM slot.
memory.target: Add an identical 64 GB module if available (part number, revision and ranks). Otherwise prefer a compatible matched 2 × 64 GB kit. Check BIOS and the MSI memory compatibility list before buying.
memory.validation: Start at DDR5-5200 MT/s (Ryzen 7 7700 specification with two modules), without EXPO; test stability and verify detected capacity before restoring application workloads.
memory.reason: RAM takes priority for containers, VMs and the ZFS ARC. Right-size limits using measured peaks and memory pressure events; a lower Docker limit does not itself free memory.
memory.budget: Compare a single module with a complete kit; no current price is guaranteed.
